gui.billboard.slot_wand: Selector wand with two marked corners
gui.billboard.slot_pixel: Pixel block (what the letters are made of)
message.billboard.aim_corner2: Corner 1 set, now aim at corner 2
message.billboard.size_not_flat: Size: %s x %s x %s, not flat (must be 1 block thick)
message.billboard.not_flat: The wall is %s x %s x %s blocks. It must be flat, 1 block thick.
message.billboard.engine_in_plane: The engine must stand behind the wall, not beside it in the same line.
message.billboard.too_big: The wall is %s x %s. Maximum is %s wide and %s high.
message.billboard.too_far: The engine is too far from the wall (max %s blocks).
message.billboard.need_wand: Put a selector wand with two marked corners in the left slot.
message.billboard.need_pixel: Put a full block in the right slot. The letters are made of it.
message.billboard.other_dimension: The marked corners are in another dimension.
message.billboard.not_loaded: Part of the wall is not loaded. Come closer.
message.billboard.started: Billboard running on a %s x %s wall.
message.billboard.stopped: Stopped. The text stays where it is until Go or Restore.
message.billboard.protected: This block belongs to an active billboard. Press Restore on its engine first.
tooltip.billboard.engine.1: Place behind a wall marked with the Selector Wand.
tooltip.billboard.engine.2: Sign on the engine + redstone pulse: shows the sign.
tooltip.billboard.engine.3: While running, follows changes to that sign.
